concurrency: No @MainActor. Configure stringsBundle once during app startup on the main thread.
overview: ZMUIToolkitStrings is the localization configuration point for the entire ZMUIToolkit framework. Every piece of user-facing text (button menus, action sheets, dialogs, toasts, settings screens, the share panel, and the QoS/statistics panel) is resolved through its internal string(for:default:) resolver. By default the toolkit ships hard-coded English fallback strings at each call site. To localize, set ZMUIToolkitStrings.stringsBundle to a bundle containing a ZMUIToolkit.strings table; the resolver looks each key up there, falling back to the built-in default when the bundle is unset or the key is missing.

members.name: stringsBundle
members.purpose: The bundle to load the ZMUIToolkit strings table from. nil by default.

members.name: stringsTable
members.purpose: The .strings table name to look up. Hard-coded to "ZMUIToolkit". Not part of the public API.

typeDefinitions.name: ZMUIToolkitStrings
typeDefinitions.notes: Caseless namespace; the framework's localization configuration point. Do not instantiate.

typeDefinitions.name: Bundle
typeDefinitions.notes: Type of stringsBundle; source of the ZMUIToolkit strings table. nil means 'use built-in defaults'.

typeDefinitions.name: stringsTable
typeDefinitions.notes: Fixed table name; implies the localization file must be named ZMUIToolkit.strings.

lifecycle.description: ZMUIToolkitStrings is pure configuration and has no SDK or session prerequisites. It is independent of ZMUIToolKitManager.initialize and can be configured before or after toolkit/SDK initialization.
setup: Add a strings table named exactly ZMUIToolkit.strings to your app target (or any bundle you control).
Add entries only for the keys you want to override; missing keys fall back to the built-in English default.
Set ZMUIToolkitStrings.stringsBundle = Bundle.main once, early (e.g. application(_:didFinishLaunchingWithOptions:)), before any toolkit UI is shown.
lifecycle.defaultBehavior: If stringsBundle is never set (remains nil), every lookup returns its built-in English default. The toolkit is fully functional and English-only in this state.
notes: No entryCallback/exitCallback; this is a synchronous configuration namespace.
Set stringsBundle before presenting toolkit UI; already-rendered text is not retroactively re-localized.

fallbacks.name: nilBundleFallback
fallbacks.result: Returns defaultValue immediately and never touches a bundle. This is the out-of-the-box English behavior.

fallbacks.name: missingKeyFallback
fallbacks.condition: Bundle set but key not found in the ZMUIToolkit table
fallbacks.result: NSBundle returns the key itself when a key is not found; the resolver detects this with value == key and returns defaultValue instead. So a missing key in a configured bundle still falls back to the built-in English default.

behaviorNotes: Provide a localized value that differs from the key name. Because the resolver detects a missing entry by comparing value == key, if a key's localized value is identical to the key itself (e.g. "cancel" = "cancel";), the built-in default is used. Localize each value to a string that differs from its key.

The table name is fixed to "ZMUIToolkit" (internal stringsTable); the file in your bundle must be named ZMUIToolkit.strings. The table name is set internally and is not configurable through the public API.
value: nil is passed to localizedString(forKey:value:table:), so NSBundle returns the key when the key is not found, which is what the value == key check relies on.

apis.name: stringsBundle
apis.description: The bundle from which the toolkit loads the ZMUIToolkit strings table. nil by default. Set to Bundle.main (or any bundle containing a ZMUIToolkit.strings table) to localize/override toolkit text; leave nil to use built-in English defaults.
sideEffects: None on assignment. The new value takes effect on the NEXT string(for:default:) lookup. Text already rendered is not retroactively updated.
apis.threading: Configure during app startup on the main thread.

apis.name: stringsTable
apis.description: The .strings table name used for all lookups. Internal; documented for completeness. Determines that the localization file must be named ZMUIToolkit.strings.

apis.name: string(for:default:)
apis.signature: internal static func string(for key: String, default defaultValue: String) -> String
apis.description: Resolver used by toolkit components to fetch a localized string. Returns the localized value from stringsBundle's ZMUIToolkit table, or defaultValue if the bundle is nil or the key is absent. Integrators do not call this directly; they influence it only by setting stringsBundle and supplying a strings table.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The lookup key in the ZMUIToolkit table.

parameters.name: default
parameters.label: defaultValue
parameters.description: The built-in English fallback used when the bundle is nil or the key is missing.

callbacks.description: ZMUIToolkitStrings defines and uses no callbacks or delegates. It is a synchronous configuration/resolver namespace.

localizedStringsCatalog.description: All toolkit text is resolved through ZMUIToolkitStrings.string(for:default:). To override an entry, set ZMUIToolkitStrings.stringsBundle and add the key to your bundle's ZMUIToolkit.strings table. Keys not present use the built-in default shown here. Keys are grouped by the source file that uses them; some keys are shared across files.

keys.default: Are you sure you want to end the session for all participants?
After the recording starts, all participants will be informed and the meeting audio, video and shared screen view will be recorded to the cloud.
You will receive an email notification when the cloud recording is ready.
All current and new participants are muted.
The session was ended by the host.
You were kicked from the session by the host.
A network error occurred, causing you to leave the session.
An unknown issue has occurred, causing you to leave the session.
By staying in this meeting, you consent to being recorded.

groups.label: QoS / Statistics panel
groups.note: This view resolves all keys through a private wrapper L(key, fallback) that delegates to ZMUIToolkitStrings.string(for:default:). The qos_* keys are shared across the Audio, Video, and Screen-sharing tabs (qos_latency, qos_jitter, qos_packet_loss, qos_resolution, qos_fps reused per tab).

count.note: 77 unique localization keys across 11 source files (95 total call sites, including shared keys such as cancel/confirm/settings/statistics and the qos_* keys reused across QoS tabs).

errorHandling.description: ZMUIToolkitStrings performs no error handling, no throwing, and no return-value inspection. The resolver cannot fail: it always returns a non-optional String. 'Failure' modes degrade gracefully to the built-in English default.

cases.situation: Bundle set, but no ZMUIToolkit.strings table
cases.result: localizedString(forKey:value:table:) returns the key -> value == key -> returns the built-in default.
Same as above -> returns the built-in default.

cases.situation: Localized value equals the key string
cases.result: Treated as missing -> returns the built-in default.

errorHandling.retryStrategy: None. There is no retry or recovery to implement; correctness is entirely a matter of providing a correctly named ZMUIToolkit.strings table with the desired keys.

required: To localize: provide a strings table file named exactly ZMUIToolkit.strings in the bundle assigned to stringsBundle. The table name is fixed internally and cannot be changed via the public API.
recommended: Set stringsBundle once, early during app startup (on the main thread), before any toolkit UI is presented. Values already rendered are not retroactively re-localized.
optional: Override only the keys you want; omitted keys fall back to built-in English defaults.
avoid: Localizing any key to a value byte-identical to its key name; the resolver treats value == key as 'not found' and returns the built-in default instead. Provide a value that differs from the key.
Instantiating ZMUIToolkitStrings; it is a caseless enum used as a namespace.
notes: string(for:default:) and stringsTable are internal; integrators interact only via stringsBundle plus the .strings table contents.

codeSnippets.name: configureLocalizationAtStartup
codeSnippets.code:
// Set once, early, on the main thread. Effective on the next string lookup.
ZMUIToolkitStrings.stringsBundle = Bundle.main
codeSnippets.usage: During app launch before presenting any toolkit UI.
codeSnippets.aiHint: Set stringsBundle exactly once during startup; do not toggle it per screen.

metadata.verification: Behaviors verified directly against ZMUIToolkitStrings.swift: the nil-bundle fallback (guard let bundle = stringsBundle else { return defaultValue }), the missing-key fallback (value == key ? defaultValue : value), and the fixed table name ("ZMUIToolkit"). The complete key catalog was compiled by grepping string(for: across all *.swift files under Sources (including the L(key, fallback) wrapper in ZMUIToolkitQoSPanel.swift); defaults are quoted verbatim from those call sites.
